__broaden__.αἰγίδ: αἰγίς — aegis, Athena’s goat-skin shield; fem. acc. sg., elided (αἰγίδ’ = αἰγίδα) · also the aegis as carried by Apollo, Zeus’s storm-shield: fem. acc. sg., elided (αἰγίδ’ = αἰγίδα)
__broaden__.κατ: κατά (elided κατ’) — down from, down along; + gen./acc.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατ’ … ἕζετο = καθέζετο ’sat down’) · also κατ’ ἔμ’ αὐτόν ’by myself, alone’ (κατά + acc.) · also κατ’ αἶσαν ’according to due measure, rightly’ (κατά + acc.) · also + acc., ’upon, against’ (κατ’ ἀσπίδα ’on the shield’) · also + acc., ’over’ (κατ’ ὄσσε ’over the eyes’) · also + acc., ’throughout’ (κατ’ Ἀχαιΐδα ’throughout Achaea’) · also + acc. of the place struck: ’in’ (κατ’ ἰγνύην ’in the hollow of the knee’) · also + gen., ’down over’ (κατ’ ὀφθαλμῶν ’down over the eyes’) · also with αὖθι, ’on the spot’ (κατ’ αὖθι) · also + acc., ’through, out along’ (κατ’ οὐταμένην ὠτειλήν ’out through the wound’) · also κατ’ ἐνῶπα ’face to face’ (κατά + acc., κατ’ ἐνῶπα ἰδών ’looking face to face’)
__broaden__.σημάντορος: σημάντωρ — one who gives orders, commander; masc. gen. sg., after δευέσθην (+ gen.) · also one who gives orders to a herd, a herdsman; masc. gen. sg., in a genitive absolute: ’no herdsman being present’ (σημάντορος οὐ παρεόντος)
__broaden__.ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἣ πληθύς ’the throng’)
__broaden__.ἤϊε: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ᾔει) · also ἤϊος — epithet of Apollo, meaning disputed (perhaps from the cry ἰή); masc. voc. sg., in address (ἤϊε Φοῖβε)
__broaden__.ὀξεῖ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; fem. nom. pl., elided (ὀξεῖ’ = ὀξεῖαι) · also fem. nom. sg., elided (ὀξεῖ’ = ὀξεῖα), agreeing with ἀϋτή: ’sharp (cry)’
__broaden__.ᾗσι: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl. · also relative, fem. dat. pl.: ’for whom’ · also ἵημι — send, hurl, throw; aor. subj. 3 sg., contracted, epic -σι (ᾗσι = ἕῃσι): ’throws’
__broaden__.ὤμοιιν: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dual gen., epic -οιιν (= Attic ὤμοιν): ’from the shoulders’ · also masc. dual dat., of place with εἱμένος: ’about the shoulders’ (ὤμοιιν νεφέλην ’a cloud about the shoulders’)
__broaden__.τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also indefinite τις after ὅς, written τίς: ’anyone, someone’ (ὅς τίς σφιν … ἡγήσαιτο ’anyone to lead them’) · also indefinite, written τίς: ’someone, one’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτε τίς τε δράκοντα ἰδών ’as when someone, seeing a snake’) · also indefinite τίς with a negative: ’no one’ (οὐ γάρ τίς … ἀνήρ ’for no man’) · also indefinite τις after μή, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’lest someone’ (μή τίς τοι … πήξῃ ’lest someone fix … in you’) · also indefinite τίς with a noun in a question after ἦ: ’some’ (ἦ τίς … θεός ’or some god’) · also indefinite τίς after μή, before the enclitic οἱ: ’lest anyone’ (μή τίς οἱ … κίοι ’lest anyone go off’) · also indefinite τίς after εἴ ποτε, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’if ever anyone’ (εἴ ποτέ τίς τοι)
